summary_en: Acquisition frame raised from 1.5M to 2.0M shares (1.81% to 2.41% of ex-treasury S/O), yen ceiling lifted from ¥2.5B to ¥4.0B. Period remains 13-Feb to 30-Dec 2026. Reason: upward revision to FY12/2026 earnings forecast; program targets 70% total payout ratio.
title_en: Notice regarding expansion of the framework for acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on provisions of the Articles of Incorporation under Article 165, paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Nakanishi Inc. announced on 7 August 2026 an expansion of its treasury share acquisition authorization under Article 165 of the Companies Act. The board, having initially resolved a buyback program on 12 February 2026, has now enlarged the acquisition frame. The maximum share count has been increased from 1.5 million to 2.0 million shares (2.41% of ex-treasury shares outstanding, as of 31 July 2026: 83,051,482 shares). The yen ceiling has been raised from ¥2.5 billion to ¥4.0 billion. The acquisition period remains unchanged at 13 February through 30 December 2026. As of 31 July 2026, zero shares and zero yen had been acquired under the initial program. The company cited upward revision of its FY12/2026 earnings forecast as the reason for the expansion, with the stated objective of achieving a 70% consolidated payout ratio.
